Monday receipt3letters→Tuesday waiting→Wednesday morning versusThursday4→Friday→Saturday; internal morning order/time unknown. Neutral TTS does not certify expressive-vs-restrained prosody or actual author anger; learner records comparative readings, those effects unscored.
